name: Civilized
description: This bug is not accustomed to hardship and pain. Whenever they have less than a full Heart Pool, the bug suffers a -1 die penalty to attack rolls and Attribute checks. This bug's minimum Belly lost per rest is 5 instead of 10.

statEffects.conditionalPenalty: -1 to attacks and checks when below full Heart

name: Dastardly
description: This bug is no stranger to desperation, and will do anything to see tomorrow. When at 1 Heart or below, this bug's Speed increases by 2, and they gain +2 dice on Soak rolls.

name: Destitute
description: This bug has struggled to get by in the wastes, and is used to running on an empty stomach. They require less Food, but have 50% the normal starting money.

name: Feral
description: This bug is not sapient, and their Insight and Soul decrease by 1. This bug's minimum Belly lost per rest is 5 instead of 10. Feral bugs may use the greater of Might or Grace for their natural weapons, but Grace-based melee attacks are at a -1 penalty unless it possesses Ranks in a Path that allows Grace for melee attacks. Feral bugs cannot use non-natural weapons and tools.

statEffects.naturalWeaponBonus: use greater of Might or Grace
statEffects.weaponRestriction: cannot use non-natural weapons and tools

name: Tool-User
description: This bug is able to use crafted weapons and tools, at a -1 die penalty.

statEffects.removesRestriction: can use crafted weapons and tools

name: Hivemind
description: This bug has an instinctual penchant for teamwork, and receives bonuses when working in tandem with allies. It gets +1 bonus die to hit a target that has been hit by an ally since this bug's last turn. Additionally, this bug gains +1 reroll to relevant rolls when crafting or performing a profession alongside another doing the same task.

name: Pampered
description: This bug is used to a life of luxury and is thus used to having plenty to eat and drink. They require more Food to stay fed, but gain 50% extra starting money.

name: Phobia
description: This bug has a debilitating fear of something in particular. When faced with its fear, the bug must make an Insight check. If failed, they receive a -1 die penalty to all rolls other than Soak and may not willingly confront their fear.

statEffects.phobiaEffect: -1 to all rolls except Soak when facing fear

name: Plucky
description: This bug has a Pool of 3 Pluck points. These may be dedicated to any roll, but add a reroll, rather than bonus die, to the roll. It may be dedicated even after the roll is made. Pluck recovers fully if the bug rests with 0 or greater Belly. Maximum Pluck is increased by 1 point for every two open trait slots the bug has.

statEffects.pluckMechanic: adds reroll to any roll, can be used after rolling

name: Talent
description: This bug has a natural penchant for a particular skill. When using that skill to add dice to a roll, one of those dice is an automatic success instead of being rolled. This Trait may be taken multiple times, but never for the same skill more than once.

statEffects.talentEffect: one automatic success for chosen skill
